fields.title: a short name for the file
fields.updated: the date the facts were last checked, like 2026-09-30
fields.sources: a list of where the facts came from

lineSource.message: This fact doesn't say where it came from. End the line with its own source in parentheses, like "(planning email, Priya Raman, 2026-09-18)".

learned.foldMessage: learned.md has {count} words. Past {limit}, say so in one line and offer to fold its entries into the main context files at the next setup refresh.

header.message: Start learned.md with a short line saying Loupe proposes these entries and a person approves each one.

learned.unknownFieldMessage: "{field}:" is not an entry field. The fields are kind, source, applies and replaces.
learned.repeatedFieldMessage: "{field}:" appears twice in this entry. Keep one.
learned.strayMessage: Each line after the header is an entry starting "- ", or one of its fields, indented, like "  kind: fact".

sentence.message: Write each entry as one plain sentence, ending with a period.

kind.message: This entry needs "kind: fact" (about the team, product or systems) or "kind: rule" (how the team wants stories written).

source.message: This entry needs a full source: who said it, how, on which story, and the date, like "source: Priya Raman, correction on skip-a-box, 2026-10-02".
source.dateMessage: The date in this source must be a real date like 2026-10-02.

applies.message: "applies:" must say when the entry holds, from a start to an end, like "applies: 1 December to 5 January".

replaces.message: "replaces:" must quote the earlier fact exactly, in double quotes.
replaces.notFoundMessage: "replaces:" quotes "{quote}", but no other context file or earlier entry says that. Quote the earlier fact exactly, and check learned.md together with the other context files.
replaces.duplicateMessage: Two entries replace "{quote}". Keep one, or have the newer entry replace the older one.

header.message: Start looks.md with a short line saying each look reads a lower environment and never changes it.

looks.unknownFieldMessage: "{field}:" is not a look field. The fields are environment, run and source.
looks.repeatedFieldMessage: "{field}:" appears twice in this look. Keep one.
looks.strayMessage: Each line after the header is a look starting "- ", or one of its fields, indented, like "  environment: staging".

sentence.message: Write each look as one plain sentence saying what it shows, ending with a period.

environment.message: This look needs "environment:" naming the lower environment it reads, like "environment: staging".
environment.neverMessage: "{value}" looks like production. Loupe never looks at production, so leave this look out.

run.message: This look needs "run:" with the exact command Loupe runs, word for word, like "run: curl -s http://localhost:8765/subscribers/{subscriber}/next-box".

id.message: "{value}" is not an id: 1 to 64 letters, digits, _ or -.

date.message: "{value}" is not a real date like 2026-10-02.

looks.shapeMessage: "{shape}" is not a placeholder shape. The shapes are {shapes}. Free text, such as an email, is never allowed.

refused.-K: reads its options from a file
refused.--config: reads its options from a file
refused.-u: puts a user name or password in the command
refused.--user: puts a user name or password in the command

required.why: so it prints what it reads and saves no file

refused.-i: reads its links from a file
refused.--input-file: reads its links from a file
refused.--user: puts a user name or password in the command
refused.--password: puts a user name or password in the command
refused.--http-user: puts a user name or password in the command
refused.--http-password: puts a user name or password in the command

required.why: so it never sends its input as data

refused.-a: puts a user name or password in the command
refused.--auth: puts a user name or password in the command

refused.-v: sets values a query can use
refused.--set: sets values a query can use
refused.--variable: sets values a query can use

refused.-p: puts a password in the command
refused.--password: puts a password in the command
refused.--local-infile: can read files on this computer

required.why: so the cluster it reads is named in the look

refused.--token: puts a token in the command
refused.-s: names a server outside its context
refused.--server: names a server outside its context

command.shellMessage: The command has {char}, which a shell reads as more than text. A look has no & | < > ` $ \ or new line anywhere, and no ; but one at the end of a query.
command.unquotedMessage: The command has "{char}" outside quotes, which a shell reads as more than text. Put it inside quotes, or leave it out.
command.quoteMessage: The command has a quote that never closes.
command.toolMessage: "{tool}" is not a look. A look runs curl, wget, HTTPie (http or https), psql, mysql, or kubectl get, describe or logs.
command.verbMessage: kubectl in a look runs {verbs}, and "{verb}" is none of them.
command.optionMessage: {tool} in a look can't use "{option}". It can use {options}.
command.clusterMessage: "{option}" joins short options that must stand alone. Write each apart, like -s -X GET.
command.urlMessage: {tool} in a look reads a full URL, starting http:// or https://, with no braces or brackets. "{token}" is not one.
command.urlCountMessage: {tool} in a look reads one URL, and this one has {count}.
command.methodMessage: {tool} in a look reads with GET or no method, not "{method}".
command.credentialsMessage: "{token}" holds a password. Keep credentials out of looks.md.
command.productionMessage: "{host}" looks like production. Loupe never looks at production. This checks the name, not where it really points.
command.queryCountMessage: {tool} in a look runs one query, given once with {options}, and this one has {count}.
command.selectMessage: A look's query is one SELECT, with no ";" but one at the end. "{query}" is not.
command.writeWordMessage: The command has "{word}", a word that writes, like {words}. A look never writes.
command.databaseMessage: {tool} in a look names one database, by a plain name like pellwick_test{uri}. "{token}" is not one.
command.secretResourceMessage: A look never reads Kubernetes secrets.
command.placeholderMessage: The placeholder {placeholder} is not inside a URL's path or query value, or inside a single-quoted SQL literal. A placeholder goes nowhere else.

fill.fileMessage: looks.md doesn't pass check-context, so no look runs. Fix this first: {problem}
fill.entryMessage: looks.md has no look number {number}. Count the looks from 1, in the order looks.md lists them.
fill.unknownNameMessage: This look has no placeholder named "{name}". Its placeholders are: {names}.
fill.repeatedNameMessage: "{name}" is given twice. Give each placeholder one value.
fill.missingNameMessage: This look needs a value for "{name}", like {name}={example}.

source.message: This look needs a source: who gave it, how, and the date, like "source: Sam Okafor, setup interview, 2026-09-30".
source.dateMessage: The date in this source must be a real date like 2026-09-30.

header.message: Start history.md with a short line saying each entry is a finished story, what was estimated and what it took.

history.unknownFieldMessage: "{field}:" is not a history field. The fields are estimated, actual and source.
history.repeatedFieldMessage: "{field}:" appears twice in this entry. Keep one.
history.duplicateMessage: Two entries are titled "{title}". Keep one, so a Calibration line names one story.
history.strayMessage: Each line after the header is a finished story's title starting "- ", or one of its fields, indented, like "  actual: 11 hours".

estimated.message: This entry needs "estimated:" with the range the story gave, like "estimated: 4 to 8 hours".
estimated.ascendingMessage: The estimate says {low} to {high} hours. The first number can't be bigger than the second.

actual.message: This entry needs "actual:" with the hours the story took, like "actual: 11 hours".

source.message: This entry needs a source: who gave the hours, from where, and the date, like "source: Priya Raman, timesheets, 2026-09-29".
source.dateMessage: The date in this source must be a real date like 2026-09-29.

messages.empty: The file is empty. Write its front matter and entries, or delete it.
messages.noFrontMatter: The file must start with front matter between two "---" lines.
messages.badDate: "{field}" must be a real date like 2026-09-30.
messages.noSources: "{field}" must list at least one place the facts came from.
messages.tooLong: The body has {count} words; the limit is {limit}. Keep only what a new team member needs.
messages.secret: This looks like {what}. Remove it. Context files must never hold secrets, credentials or customer data.
messages.stale: Last updated {date}, {days} days ago. Check the facts are still true, then update the date.
messages.future: "{field}" is {date}, after today, {today}. Set it to the date the facts were last checked.
